title: GPU
description: UUID of the NVIDIA GPU models run on (GPU-… or MIG-…). Leave empty to use the card with the most memory; if the saved card is gone, the load uses that card and says so. Applies from the next model load.

title: Context Length
description: Maximum prompt plus reply length in tokens, fixed when the model starts. A longer request is refused with context_length_exceeded instead of restarting the model. Applies from the next model load.

title: Max Output Tokens
description: Longest reply per request. Atomic Chat caps each request's max_tokens to this value on its way to the model; it is not an engine setting. Must be less than the context length. Applies from the next model load.

title: KV Cache Memory Fraction
description: Share of the GPU memory still free after the weights load that the engine reserves for its KV cache. Applies from the next model load.

title: Load Timeout (seconds)
description: How long a load may take before it fails. 0 estimates it from the model's size. Applies from the next model load.
